label: DAG
blurb: Nodes and parent links, laid out as a tidy tree. Drag to reparent.

nodes.doc: each { id, title, parent, status, order, note, pos }

columns.doc: status values; yours, any names, any count

height.doc: any CSS length; a number is read as px

density.doc: node spacing for the tidy-tree layout

controls.label: Add root
controls.title: Create a new root node
controls.doc: Add a node with no parent.

controls.label: Re-layout
controls.title: Discard manual positions and re-tidy the tree
controls.doc: Re-tidy the tree, throwing away positions a drag has set.

controls.label: Fit
controls.title: Fit the whole graph in view
controls.doc: Zoom and centre so the whole graph is visible.

controls.label: Add child
controls.title: Create a new node parented to this one
controls.doc: Add a node under the selected one.

controls.label: Auto-place
controls.title: Drop the manual position and let layout decide

controls.label: Delete
controls.title: Delete this node
controls.doc: Delete the selected node, after a confirm.

gestures: drop one node ON another to reparent
notes: `pos` exists only where the human dragged a node — delete it to let the layout place it again.
